messages:
alex.chen: CI is red on main — several GitHub Actions jobs failing with KMS decrypt errors during secrets sync. job: build-and-test (ubuntu-22). anyone oncall?

ci-bot: build-and-test #456 failed (see checks). reason: KMSDecryptDenied.
```
2026-03-17T13:58:02Z ERROR KMS: AccessDenied: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/redwood-ci-key: Permission denied for serviceAccount: gha-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
 stderr: Error: could not decrypt environment secret
```

maria.garcia: @oncall-eng can you check the vault -> GHA secret sync? I rotated a CI key earlier today, possible propagation gap.

oncall-eng: looking now. quick grep of audit logs shows an IAM policy update at 2026-03-17T13:57 by infra-automation-bot. leaning toward binding removal.

sam: I ran the rotation workflow yesterday but it should only add new keys. I didn't remove the decrypter binding. Will check the rotation run logs.

jordan: can someone trigger a rerun of just the failing job for PR #987 so we know if it's transient or still permission-related? @alex.chen share the sha.

alex.chen: sha abcdef1234. repro locally: `gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=infra --key=redwood-ci-key --ciphertext-file=secret.bin` -> AccessDenied.

maria.garcia: short-term workaround: set workflow env to use fallback key (KMS_KEY=projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/fallback-key) and re-run. not great but will unblock.

sam: I can re-add the binding now: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding redwood-ci-key --member=serviceAccount:gha-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and then request a rerun.

oncall-eng: please proceed and document who made the change. also we should bisect to find which automation changed the binding. @deploy-bot can you run the secret-sync job on demand?

deploy-bot: manual trigger accepted by oncall-eng. secret-sync run id: secret-sync-20260317-71 queued. will post status.

ci-bot: rerun requested by sam for build-and-test #456. queued to runner pool.

jordan: if rerun succeeds, let's follow up with a short incident note in #incidents and add a guard to the rotation script. also add an alert for KMS IAM policy changes.

alex.chen: FYI pinging reviewers: @maria.garcia @sam — please leave a quick comment on PR 1012 so downstream jobs aren't blocked waiting for triage.

sam: binding restored. running rerun. added a one-line rollback to rotation job to prevent accidental removals.

ci-bot: build-and-test #456 rerun succeeded — all checks green.

alex.chen: :tada: nice work. follow-ups (action items): 1) put IAM-change alert in monitoring, 2) add guard/validation in rotation workflow, 3) doc quick rerun steps in runbook. I'll open a short follow-up ticket.

jordan: awesome, closing loop. thanks everyone.
